landing.pricingIncludedBody: Both plans keep the core workflow intact. Annual billing adds the highest-value automation for teams ready to scale.
landing.howItWorksTitle: From first call to final invoice
landing.howItWorksSubtitle: A simple operating flow that turns conversations into organized work, without making customers download an app.
landing.workflowStep1Body: Calls, texts, photos, and project details become a structured lead with the next action already clear.
landing.workflowStep2Body: The system helps estimate labor, materials, margin, and client price so you can respond while the lead is still warm.
landing.workflowStep3Body: Approved jobs move into dispatch, project tracking, job costing, and invoice handoff without duplicate entry.
landing.workflowBottomTitle: Built around how contractors already communicate
landing.workflowBottomBody: Customers keep using calls and text messages. Your team gets the organized CRM, calendar, quote, project, and financial view behind the scenes.

landing.pricingPremium8: Priority onboarding and CRM migration help
landing.pricingPremium9: Quarterly workflow reviews with your team
landing.phoneBubble1: Hi, I saw your missed call. Looks like an HVAC tune-up. You can upload photos here:
landing.phoneBubble3: Got it. Choose a time here:
landing.phoneBubble4: Booked for tomorrow at 1 PM. I’ll text if anything changes.
landing.step1Body: Your autonomous AI acts as a 24/7 digital receptionist. It answers calls, responds to texts, and automatically extracts project details into a structured lead card, ensuring no job slips through the cracks.
landing.step2ProjectDesc: Backyard landscaping for Sarah Johnson. Need to install 1,200 sq ft of premium sod, build a 10x12 paver patio with natural stone, and plant 3 shade trees (oak or maple). Include soil prep and grading.
landing.step2DescribeBody: The agent immediately calculates an intelligent estimate analyzing labor, your custom GC margin, and materials. Delivering competitive quotes to clients in seconds instead of days.
landing.step3Body: Upon job approval, the Voice AI agent automatically sources the right subcontractor based on specialty, priority, and location. It makes the phone call, negotiates availability, and dispatches the crew hands-free.
landing.step4Body: During execution, the platform handles complex job costing dynamically mapping GC costs against client prices. Finally, the system automatically translates completed project scope into synchronized QuickBooks invoices.
landing.step4BodyOld: AI recommends the best products for your project needs with real-time pricing and availability.
landing.step5ReplyPrompt: Reply YES to add to your calendar, or NO to skip.
landing.step5MeetingScheduled: Meeting scheduled with Customer on 2026-01-20 at 1:00 PM!
landing.step5CalendarLinkSent: Calendar link automatically sent to customer to book based on your availability
landing.step5Body: AI automatically detects scheduling conversations in your SMS and helps book meetings instantly. Customers receive a calendar link to select times based on your availability—no back-and-forth needed.
landing.featuresSectionTitle: One clean workspace for the whole job
landing.featuresSectionSubtitle: ContractorOps AI keeps the front office moving: it captures leads, follows up, dispatches crews, and keeps financials organized.
landing.featuresFinBody: See cost, price, margin, and invoice status without rebuilding the same numbers.
landing.featuresCallsBody: The AI answers, texts back, collects details, and keeps the lead organized.
landing.featureEstimateBody: Turn scope into a clear estimate while the lead is still warm.
landing.featuresDispatchBody: The voice agent calls available subs and moves down the list until the job is covered.
landing.featuresPmBody: Tasks, scopes, documents, and crew handoffs stay attached to the project so nothing disappears after the quote.
landing.featureInboxBody: Photos uploaded, address verified, urgent today.
landing.featureInboxReply: I can send available times and collect access notes before the visit.
landing.featuresProofTitle: Designed to feel calm on day one
landing.featuresProofBody: First-time visitors see the system in plain terms: answer faster, quote cleaner, dispatch smarter, and keep the money organized.
